title: Contrix Space
description: A Space is a structural grouping object inside a Realm. Boards, lists, swimlanes, calendar buckets, document outline groups, etc. are all Spaces. Authorization-transparent: never carries its own membership/policy/E2EE group; its metadata may be placed in an existing Realm/Circle effective scope via scope_circle_id.

realm_id.description: Home Realm that stores, syncs, and authorizes this Space object's own metadata. This is also the fallback default Realm for new resources under this Space when default_realm_id is absent.

default_realm_id.description: Optional default Realm for resources created under this Space. Omitted means inherit from the nearest ancestor Space with default_realm_id, falling back to realm_id. This field does not grant membership or decryption rights.

scope_circle_id.description: Optional Circle scope for this Space object's own metadata and scoped structural relation facts. Space still does not own a security boundary; it only places its metadata into an existing Circle scope. Omitted means Realm-default scope.

default_scope_circle_id.description: Optional default Circle scope for newly created child resources. MUST belong to the Space's effective default_realm_id for those child resources (which may be inherited); it is not necessarily the Space metadata home Realm when cross-Realm defaults are configured. This is a creation hint, not an authorization or placement constraint; use child_scope_policy for reducer-enforced requirements.

child_scope_policy.description: Reducer-enforced placement/encryption policy for child resources created in or moved into this Space.

parent_space_id.description: Optional parent in the structural hierarchy. Parent MAY live in a different Realm; such a link is navigation only and never propagates membership, capabilities, history, E2EE keys, retention, or federation policy.

kind.description: Space kind. v1 standard kinds include 'space', 'project', 'folder', 'board', and 'list'. Profile-defined kinds (e.g., 'swimlane', 'calendar_bucket', 'page_group') MAY be added via Realm schema/profile and MUST be registered. Unknown kind MUST schema_violation.

rank.description: Fractional-index rank within parent. See encoding.md §9.

schema_refs.description: Optional schema/profile references that further constrain this Space's contained Flow types, fields, or position invariants.

fields.description: Space kind-specific fields, e.g., { 'wip_limit': 5 } for kind=list, { 'view_id': 'cx:view:...' } for kind=board's default view. MUST NOT contain a 'rank' key (rank is a top-level Space field; see relation.md §2 for the symmetric Relation constraint and forbidden-wire-fields.json `fields.rank/space_payload`).

state.description: Space lifecycle state. 'active' is the default. State transitions are reducer-enforced per common-fields.md §5.1: cx.space.archive MUST come from state=='active' (else failed_precondition reason=space_not_active); cx.space.restore MUST come from state=='archived' (else failed_precondition reason=space_not_archived); cx.space.tombstone MUST come from {'active','archived'} AND must have no live dependents (failed_precondition reason=space_already_terminal for terminal source, space_has_live_dependents for live refs). Same-state self-transitions (archive on archived, etc.) MUST fail; clients re-archive by restore-then-archive. Tombstoned is irreversible (MUST NOT be restored). The transition timestamp lives on the writing Move and on state_changed_at.

state_changed_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent state transition. Required when state != 'active'.
